name: Connectome Workbench -metric-resample
purpose: Resamples a metric file, given two spherical surfaces that are in register.

inputs.statement: The metric file to resample, typically a native-mesh metric.
inputs.quote: <metric-in> - the metric file to resample, typically a native-mesh metric

inputs.statement: A sphere surface in register with the new sphere and having the mesh the metric is currently on.
inputs.quote: <current-sphere> - a sphere surface that is in register with <new-sphere>

inputs.statement: A sphere surface that is the desired output mesh, typically a standard sphere.
inputs.quote:
<new-sphere> - a sphere surface that the desired output mesh, typically a
standard sphere

conditions.statement: The method argument must be one of ADAP_BARY_AREA or BARYCENTRIC.
conditions.quote: The <method> argument must be one of the following:

conditions.statement: If ADAP_BARY_AREA is used, exactly one of -area-surfs or -area-metrics must be specified.
conditions.quote:
If ADAP_BARY_AREA is used, exactly one of -area-surfs or
-area-metrics must be specified.

steps.statement: Provide the input metric, current sphere, new sphere, method name, and output metric path.
steps.quote:
wb_command -metric-resample
<metric-in> - the metric file to resample, typically a native-mesh metric

steps.statement: Optionally specify -area-surfs with current-area and new-area surfaces for vertex area correction.
steps.quote: [-area-surfs] - specify surfaces to do vertex area correction based on

steps.statement: Optionally specify -area-metrics with current-area and new-area vertex area metric files.
steps.quote:
[-area-metrics] - specify vertex area metrics to do area correction based
on

steps.statement: Optionally use -current-roi to exclude non-data vertices via an input roi metric.
steps.quote:
[-current-roi] - use an input roi on the current mesh to exclude non-data
vertices

steps.statement: Optionally use -largest to use only the value of the vertex with the largest weight.
steps.quote: [-largest] - use only the value of the vertex with the largest weight

steps.statement: Optionally use -bypass-sphere-check to allow spheres of arbitrary shape following the same contour.
steps.quote:
[-bypass-sphere-check] - ADVANCED: allow the current and new 'spheres' to
have arbitrary shape as long as they follow the same contour

checks.statement: The current sphere must be in register with the new sphere.
checks.quote: <current-sphere> - a sphere surface that is in register with <new-sphere>

exceptions.statement: The -current-roi option only masks the input; the output may be slightly dilated in comparison.
exceptions.quote:
The -current-roi option only masks the input, the output may be slightly
dilated in comparison

outputs.statement: Optional ROI of vertices that got data from valid source vertices, output as a metric.
outputs.quote:
[-valid-roi-out] - output the ROI of vertices that got data from valid
source vertices

parameters.statement: The method name, one of ADAP_BARY_AREA or BARYCENTRIC.
For -area-surfs, a current-area anatomical surface with current-sphere mesh and a new-area surface with new-sphere mesh.
parameters.quote:
<current-area> - a relevant anatomical surface with <current-sphere>
mesh

parameters.statement: For -area-metrics, a current-area metric file with vertex areas for current-sphere mesh and a new-area metric file for new-sphere mesh.
parameters.quote:
<current-area> - a metric file with vertex areas for <current-sphere>
mesh

parameters.statement: For -current-roi, the roi as a metric file.
parameters.quote: <roi-metric> - the roi, as a metric file
